description: Download public Pinterest images, GIFs and videos into the run's file store. Choose a mode, then paste Pin links or search phrases.

commerceOnly.description: Keep only Pins with Pinterest product or shopping metadata.
commerceOnly.title: Shoppable Pins only

excludeAds.description: Exclude Pins that Pinterest marks as promoted.
excludeAds.title: Exclude promoted Pins

imageSize.description: Preferred image size. The actor falls back to the original or the nearest available size. Animated GIFs are always saved at their original size.
imageSize.title: Image size

includeComments.description: Also emit public comment and activity rows for every processed Pin.
includeComments.title: Include comments and activity

maxComments.description: Maximum public comment/activity rows per Pin when comments are enabled.
maxComments.title: Maximum comments per Pin

maxItems.description: Maximum files to download per Pin URL or search phrase. Set to 0 to follow the available results.
maxItems.title: Maximum media items

maxPages.description: Maximum result pages per search phrase. Set to 0 to follow Pinterest's pagination until it ends.
maxPages.title: Maximum search pages

mediaType.description: Download all media, only images (GIFs count as images), only videos, or only animated GIFs.
mediaType.title: Media type

minCreatorFollowers.description: Keep media only when Pinterest reports at least this many creator followers.
minCreatorFollowers.title: Minimum creator followers

minSaves.description: Keep media only when Pinterest reports at least this many saves.
minSaves.title: Minimum saves

mode.description: Auto handles both Pin links and search phrases. Choose a specific mode to restrict the run to links or search.
mode.title: What to download

pinUrls.description: Public Pin links (https://www.pinterest.com/pin/123...) or numeric Pin IDs. Used by auto and pinDetail.
pinUrls.title: Pinterest Pin URLs or IDs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy override. The actor works without a proxy and only escalates when Pinterest blocks a request.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration (optional)

requireOutboundLink.description: Keep only Pins that publish a destination URL.
requireOutboundLink.title: Require destination link

searchTerms.description: Pinterest search phrases. Used by auto, searchPins and searchVideos.
searchTerms.title: Search phrases

verifiedOnly.description: Keep only media whose creator Pinterest marks as verified.
verifiedOnly.title: Verified creators only

videoQuality.description: Preferred MP4 quality. The actor falls back to the nearest available quality and prefers H.264 MP4 files.
videoQuality.title: Video quality

title: Pinterest Media Downloader Input
